high_level_description: The image is a split-screen presentation during what appears to be an academic or professional lecture. Below the title, there are six columns of small images arranged in a grid format, each representing different scenes such as offices, grocery stores, and other indoor environments. At the bottom of the slide, there is a reference to the source of the data, which includes authors' names and the conference where it was presented (CoRL 2022).
